[FACT] User has a wine stain on the left couch cushion.  
[TEMPORAL] The wine stain has been lingering since the user's sister's visit two Sundays ago.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested cleaning method for the wine stain:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Blot the stain with a clean cloth, then use a solution of equal parts white vinegar and water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Let the solution sit for about 10 minutes before blotting again.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If the stain persists, consider using a stain remover or professional cleaning.
